scope: Bounded mechanism-oriented search, not a systematic review or universal novelty claim.

databases.name: arXiv
databases.query: all:"trajectory prediction" AND all:"probability calibration" AND all:"optimal transport"
databases.interpretation: No direct match was indexed for this exact narrow query; this does not establish absence from the literature.

sources.title: Evaluation of Trajectory Distribution Predictions with Energy Score
sources.role: Supports Energy Score as a proper trajectory-distribution metric and the inadequacy of min-of-N as a probability score.

sources.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasts based on Aggregation and Transformation
sources.role: Supports complementary proper scores for distinct forecast features.

sources.title: Evaluating Posterior Probabilities: Decision Theory, Proper Scoring Rules, and Calibration
sources.role: Supports using expected proper scores for posterior assessment and treating ECE as diagnostic.

sources.title: Proper Scoring Rules, Gradients, Divergences, and Entropies for Paths and Time Series
sources.role: Supports respecting path-space structure in probabilistic forecasting.

sources.title: Scenario Reduction Revisited: Fundamental Limits and Guarantees
sources.role: Supports transport-based comparison of finite discrete probability supports and its limits.

sources.title: Decision-Aware Training for Sample-Based Generative Models
sources.role: Recent adjacent evidence that decision-sensitive and probabilistic forecast objectives can be combined; not treated as validation of TPMO.

local_overlap_boundary.C99: Voronoi score/geometry decoupling, closed before model training after its gradient-interference mechanism failed.
local_overlap_boundary.C95_C150: Continuous density or transport support construction followed by finite support extraction; not cross-support posterior transport.
local_overlap_boundary.C128_C136: Direct learned candidate posterior or regret heads; TPMO has zero trainable parameters and starts from a frozen B0 measure.
local_overlap_boundary.C134: Target-free Energy simplex optimization on one support; TPMO adds exact cross-support probability transport and a fixed KL proximal anchor.

novelty_statement: Within the recorded bounded searches and local route audit, no direct method was found that transports a calibrated finite trajectory measure between independently learned K=5 supports by exact permutation marginalization and then applies a target-free Energy-KL proximal solve. This is a bounded candidate contribution, not a universal novelty claim.
coverage_limitations: The exact arXiv conjunction is narrow and returned zero results.
Crossref relevance search did not return the PMLR paper in its first five records.
OpenAlex had no remaining daily query budget and unauthenticated Semantic Scholar was rate-limited during the preceding strategy audit.
Publisher full texts were not exhaustively searched.
